build_EScAIP_backbone: build an EScAIP backbone model with graph attention blocks for molecular property prediction
create_EScAIP_energy_head: create an EScAIP energy head to predict molecular energy from backbone node or global features
create_EScAIP_direct_force_head: create an EScAIP direct force head to predict atomic forces from edge and node features
